historical_anchor.historical_TF58: 15 carriers = 7 CV + 8 CVL, generally about 930 carrier aircraft; departed Majuro 6 Jun for FORAGER.

branch_fast_carrier_OOB_5Jun.note: Enterprise is a permanent Branch loss; surviving CV-7 Wasp approximately replaces the historical Enterprise-sized deck, while Intrepid remains an additional Essex deck because her historical Feb torpedo campaign-out did not occur. Cabot has crossed the branch May return gate by early June.

logistics.Rainier_AE5: Arrives Majuro 31 May. Historical 1-5 Jun issue cycle supplied about 1,600 tons of ammunition to TF58 before the 6 Jun sortie.
logistics.Majuro: Dense carrier/battleship/service concentration and ammunition/fuel handling create a short high-value window.
logistics.scheduled_sortie: 6 Jun remains the operational center before the special-strike result is applied; 15 Jun Saipan D-Day remains fixed absent a major shock.

guard: Do not reuse legacy 7-CV/8-CVL June settlement. This 8-CV/8-CVL pool is the current pre-combat branch baseline before any 6-20 Jun losses/detachments.
